AE 1.0.0-aether · Windows 10/11 · x86-64

Download AE

A complete operating system in a single executable — its own window, its own compositor, its own file manager, editor, terminal, calculator and browser. No installer, no runtime, no dependencies.

Install it

↓ Install AE
821,760 bytes installs to %LOCALAPPDATA%\AE adds a Start-menu shortcut

Downloads install-ae.cmd. Double-click it: it fetches AE, verifies the SHA-256, installs it and starts it.

Windows will warn that the publisher is unknown, because the binary is not code-signed. Choose More info → Run anyway. You can read the installer before running it — it is a text file.

Or run one line in PowerShell

powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "irm https://github.com/SPORstudio-Official/moddelingmym/raw/arena/1c294196-moddelingmym/dist/install-ae.ps1 | iex"

Press Win, type powershell, paste, Enter. Same installer, no download step.

Or just take the executable

↓ AE.exe — run it directly
SHA-256 99349ca3…0e24a5cc no install, no traces

What happens after you click

  1. Verify — the SHA-256 of the download is checked before anything runs.
  2. Install — AE.exe is written to %LOCALAPPDATA%\AE.
  3. Shortcut — an AE entry appears in the Start menu.
  4. Launch — AE opens as a native Win32 window and boots in about 2.6 s.

Not on Windows?

↓ AE.html — runs in any browser

The same operating system, compiled to WebAssembly, in one page. Works on macOS and Linux. Search needs the Windows build: a page cannot send the POST an MCP server requires.
